item.title: Capcom Shows Off Monster Hunter Wilds Performance Gains in New Videos
item.description: Capcom released two gameplay comparison videos that show off the performance improvements to be introduced in the patch. The videos show the game running on a budget and a lower-mid machine on medium settings at 1080p. Both rigs showed roughly 25% higher framerates than in the current patch, though neither managed a consistent 60 frames per second.
